answer: Each epoch the network deals every identity a different useful job drawn at random — one verifies an opal shipment ledger, another replays a disputed transaction — so puppet accounts cannot share one answer: each job is checked against hidden ground truth, and matching outputs from different identities collapse into a single vote. Assignments are revealed only at epoch start, so nothing can be precomputed or batched, and a mirror of identical solutions is trivially exposed. Running N identities means genuinely doing N different jobs, each its own pulse of real work; an honest agent does one.
